name: Mind Blank
summary: Grants a willing creature Immunity to Psychic damage, charms, and mind-reading divination for 24 hours.

stats.effect: Until the spell ends, one willing creature you touch has {ref:glossary/immunity} to Psychic damage and the {ref:condition/charmed} condition. The target is also unaffected by anything that would sense its emotions or alignment, read its thoughts, or magically detect its location, and no spell—not even *{ref:spell/wish}*—can gather information about the target, observe it remotely, or control its mind.
